cohort: Female same-sex couples using donor semen who became pregnant (88 following ROPA, 489 following IUI) were included from a single fertility clinic.
finding: ROPA pregnancies were associated with a higher incidence of preterm birth and first-trimester bleeding, and a significantly higher incidence of preterm pre-eclampsia, particularly following artificially prepared frozen embryo transfer.
mod_finding: No statistically significant differences were observed regarding Caesarean section rates between ROPA and IUI pregnancies.
